quarterly_data.quarter: Adeia press release: Adeia Renews IP License Agreement with Spectrum (10-05-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Customer Charter Communications (Spectrum): Adeia entered into a multi-year renewal of its intellectual property (IP) license agreement with Charter Communications, Inc., through its Spectrum brand. The agreement renews Spectrum's license to Adeia's media IP portfolio across its pay-TV and other video services and also includes coverage for Spectrum's broadband and mobility businesses; the release calls it the latest in a series of renewals with Spectrum, whose relationship with Adeia and its predecessor companies spans more than two decades. Chief revenue officer Dr. Mark Kokes: the renewal 'underscores the enduring strength and relevance of our media IP portfolio in the pay-TV market', and the extension to broadband and mobility reflects 'the growing relevance of our innovations as video, broadband and mobile services increasingly converge.' No financial terms are stated.
